_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Cal 3 now completes its five-second resting countdown reliably when the syringe stops. Isolated NI-DAQ sample noise no longer repeatedly restarts the timer; sustained flow or renewed movement restarts all five seconds. The live graph shows the actual rest band with solid lines and the stroke-start threshold with dashed lines.

Flow calibration always fits independent Kp and Kn from each direction's mean whole-stroke nominal volume. Every raw flow sample remains integrated on the NI-DAQ clock. Stored calibration is preserved until a complete reviewed result passes the existing save and read-back gates.

Validated by recorded-trace replay, 500 Hz noisy-tail and renewed-motion tests, volume/timebase checks, and full offline application checks. Firmware and preset control are unchanged. Physical syringe accuracy requires a new operator calibration.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
